Haptics · VR · HCI

Takumi Hamazaki

Researcher, Toyota Central R&D Labs / Working PhD Student, Kajimoto Lab — The University of Electro-Communications

My research interests include human perception, especially tactile illusions, as well as haptic interfaces and sensing. I investigate interface design and psychophysical experiments that make use of these illusions, and one of my current PhD themes is chemical haptics.
